field.name: recurTimeZone
field.description: The time zone (an IANA name) a recurring base's cadence (recurCronExpression) is read in; the machine's, as the job's, when empty.

field.name: recurFromDate
field.description: A recurring base's first moment: no occurrence before it is ordered.

field.name: recurThruDate
field.description: A recurring base's end: no occurrence at or after it is ordered (an ended base).

field.name: recurPausedDate
field.description: Set while a recurring base is paused: the worker orders nothing for it, and the occurrences that fall in the pause are skipped.

field.name: recurResumedDate
field.description: When a paused base was resumed: occurrences before it are not ordered late.

field.name: recurAgreementId
field.description: The customer agreement (AgrSales or AgrProduct) a recurring base is kept under: an occurrence is ordered only while it applies (active, in its dates, of the seller with the customer).

field.name: recurRevision
field.description: A recurring base's revision, counted by each change of its recurrence in Sales and named by the next one.

field.name: recurFailureDate
field.description: When a recurring base's last occurrence failed; empty after one succeeds.

field.name: recurFailureMessage
field.description: Why a recurring base's last occurrence failed.

field.name: recurOccurrenceDate
field.description: On an order generated from a recurring base: the scheduled occurrence it was made for (one order for an occurrence).
